description: Creates a parameter of a report, linked to the dashboard filters given, as the app's report parameters editor does. With a value, writes it into those filters and reads their datasheets again. Answers the parameter. Only the report's editors may.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

filterIds.description: The filters the parameter links, by their `id` in `filters` from `getReportParameters`: its value is written into each, in every datasheet that reads its dashboard. Each must have no `parameterId` yet. A burst can vary by the parameter only if one of them has a `valueType`.

name.description: The parameter's name, as shown in Rollstack. It can't be the name of another parameter of the report.

value.description:
The parameter's value, of the `valueType` of the filters it links. When set, it is written into those filters and their datasheets are read again with it, so the report's slides change. If `null` or omitted, as for a parameter a burst's variants will set, the filters keep their own values. A value of a report parameter, in the shape of its type. Copy the shape of the parameter's `value` in `listBursts`, or of a variant's in `listBurstVariants`:

- A list of values: `{ "type": "categorical", "values": ["EMEA"] }`, with at least one value. `operator` can also be `is_not`, `contains` or `doesnt_contain`; it is `is` when left out.
- A number: `{ "type": "number", "value": 10 }`. Text: `{ "type": "text", "value": "EMEA" }`.
- A date range: `{ "type": "date", "subtype": "date_range", "startDate": "2026-01-01", "endDate": "2026-03-31" }`. One date: `{ "type": "date", "subtype": "date_single", "date": "2026-03-31" }`.
- A month or a quarter: `{ "type": "date", "subtype": "date_month_year", "month": 3, "year": 2026 }` (months 1 to 12), `{ "type": "date", "subtype": "date_quarter_year", "quarter": 1, "year": 2026 }`.
- A relative period: `{ "type": "date", "subtype": "date_relative", "rangeType": "lastN", "rangeN": 3, "periodType": "months" }`. `rangeType` is `current`, `lastN` or `nextN`; `periodType` is `days`, `weeks`, `months`, `quarters` or `years`, or `completeDays` through `completeYears` for whole periods only.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

name: createReportParameter
title: Create report parameter
